source.caption: Comparison of SHAP-based feature contributions between the Random Forest and Gradient Boosting models. We calculated SHAP values for the top 20 features to quantify the relative importance and direction of estimation influence on modeled PM 2.5 concentrations across the tree-based learners. Details of SHAP calculation and interpretation are described in the methods section.
